policy: No adoption without acceptable license/provenance, demonstrated 4.7.1 compatibility, isolated A/B proof, Web/GL Compatibility impact measurement, and measured superiority over any working project-specific system.

candidates.name: Beehave
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Store changelog states v2.9.3 is compatible with latest Godot 4.7.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Recent 2026-08-18 release; store description states automated test coverage and built-in performance monitors.
candidates.reason: Promising maintained AI tooling, but no isolated Grand Bruxelles Web/GL performance/export A/B exists and current NPC runtime ownership must not be displaced without measured superiority.

candidates.name: Dialogue Manager
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Store minimum is Godot 4.6; explicit 4.7.1 qualification was not found in this audit.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Updated 2026-09-06 with active-maintainer community evidence on the official store.
candidates.reason: Do not integrate until 4.7.1 and Web/GL compatibility are demonstrated in isolation; dialogue is not the current visible CIV-1 blocker.

candidates.name: Universal Animation Library
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Official upstream states custom exports work in Godot and that the universal humanoid rig is ready for retargeting; neither upstream nor store establishes exact Godot 4.7.1 qualification.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Official upstream v3.0 dated 2026-06-16 adds root motion to locomotion/movement animations and fixes 8-direction step synchronization so all start with the left foot. Both root-motion and root-motion-disabled exports are provided. The Godot store remains on its separately labelled Standard-1.0 listing and marks that store version unstable.
candidates.reason: The upstream v3.0 locomotion fixes directly target foot-slide/transition risk, but store metadata is not sufficient evidence and a 2026 store review reports UpperChest deformation on other characters. Acquire only from the official upstream/store, record archive and extracted-file hashes, then require CIV-1 Skeleton3D/BoneMap retarget A/B, root-motion versus in-place comparison, foot-slide/grounding measurements, Web/GL cost, and real 1280x720 player-view proof before adoption.

candidates.name: Character State Machine
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Official store declares minimum Godot 4.6 and maximum Godot 4.7.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Recent 2026 release but no reviews; publisher marks version unstable.
candidates.reason: Version range is promising but 4.7.1 patch-level and Web/GL behavior are not proven; no reason to replace project-specific state handling without measured superiority.

next_executable_action: Acquire Universal Animation Library v3.0 only from the recorded official upstream/store path. Record SHA-256 for the downloaded archive and every imported source payload before extraction/import. In an isolated Character branch compare root-motion and root-motion-disabled locomotion against CIV-1: inspect Skeleton3D/BoneMap mapping and UpperChest deformation, measure root displacement versus CharacterBody velocity plus planted-foot world drift for idle/walk/run, verify grounding at 2-8 m, measure Web/GL frame cost, and capture a real 1280x720 player-view artifact. Do not merge on store metadata alone.
